seo.title: What Do We Wear? ☀️❄️ Clothes Names for Kids | Weather Guessing Game | Unique Kiddo
seo.description:
Sunny, rainy, windy or snowy, what do we wear? 🤔 Look at the weather clues and guess with Kiddo!

A quick clothes and weather guessing game for kids. Children learn 4 clothes names:
🕶️ Sunglasses (sunny day)
🥾 Boots (rainy day)
🧣 Scarf (windy day)
🧤 Gloves (snowy day)

Each round has think time so kids can guess, and a "say it with me" pause to practise new English words. Great for toddlers, preschool and kindergarten (ages 2–6).

⭐ Subscribe to Unique Kiddo for more fun learning games: animals, vehicles, letters, numbers and more!

Voice: Kokoro TTS (Apache 2.0) · Emoji art: Noto Emoji (Apache 2.0)
